Self-RAG is different from traditional RAG in several ways. Firstly, it does not retrieve passages indiscriminately, but instead, it evaluates the necessity of retrieval and only retrieves passages when needed. Secondly, it concurrently processes multiple retrieved passages and evaluates their relevance, whereas traditional RAG retrieves a fixed number of documents regardless of the retrieval necessity.
